sources.evidence: Prepare a plastic bottle, set target recycling bin, drop bottle, redeem. Existing recycling-bin network, youth challenges, leaderboards, merchants and recycling companies. Proposed fees for merchant transactions and facilitated challenges. Historical statistics and incomplete validation placeholders are not repeated in exhibit.

sources.title: Project source folder
sources.coverage: Inventory reviewed. Adobe XD, video mockups, presentation variants and prototype files located; XD and videos not opened or claimed as reviewed.

interpretation: The app screens are a redesigned concept, not the original running app. The mall nook, leaf reward plaque and navigation marker are visual metaphors. Existing wood-clad bins and the AR recognition sequence follow the exported prototype. No production computer-vision verification or actual reward redemption is claimed.
animation: 30-second deterministic loop: locate 0–4s; route 4–11s; arrive and recognize 11–15s; bottle deposit 16–19s; reward only from 19s; settle and reset 27–30s. No reverse bottle motion. UI and 3D share the same state.
generation: Built-in image generation, new opaque image; final prompt in outputs/kitar-review/artwork-prompt.txt.
verification: Two targeted tests cover causal timing, route monotonicity, vertical deposit, deterministic reset/seek, finite geometry and mesh budget. Standard card with artwork/3D toggle, rotation, reset and pause. Final production build: 97 pages, 0 check errors. Browser verified artwork/3D switching, animated recognition/deposit/reward sequence, reset/pause/resume, both themes and no console errors. Geometry: 78 meshes, 77,658 triangles.
